endpoints.call: the careers RSS is a usable public feed (site terms forbid crawling / scraping the HTML, so use the feed only)
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Terms: users may not use the site 'to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape'. Public RSS feed offered by the site; no developer API; robots.txt empty.

search.note: Work With Indies RSS 2.0 feed (latest ~100 jobs at independent game studios). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<studio> is hiring a <role> to work from <location>'. id is the job link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
